comment: UnitEcon reads its settings with defaults in code and does not seed a row on read, so this fixture is what turns the defaults into a deliberate configuration. `acquisitionAccountIds` is a REPLACE list, not a merge - the seeder sends the full set. Marketing (6400) and the account-management share of salaries are what this business actually spends to acquire a customer; rent and audit fees are not, and including them would inflate CAC into meaninglessness. Product lines map to revenue accounts because the PVM decomposition's product dimension IS the revenue account - that is why the dataset creates 4300 and 4400 on top of the default chart, so the decomposition has four lines rather than two.
